verdicts.quote: a member who satisfies the requirements for confirmation gets a confirmed booking without taking a further waitlist action. Source: choice: Automatic allocation fills available places without a separate claim window.
Allocation selects eligible entries in the order those entries became active
verdicts.missing: How ties between entries with the same join time resolve, and whether any membership tier or staff override can jump the queue.

verdicts.quote: a member can cancel a confirmed booking under the same terms as before, including a booking obtained through the waitlist.
verdicts.missing: Whether a missed or unwanted automatic promotion counts against the existing no-show or late-cancellation policy.

verdicts.quote: The app automatically confirms a booking for the selected eligible waiting member when a place becomes available
verdicts.missing: That promotion runs as background work, and how quickly it must happen after the triggering cancellation or capacity change.

verdicts.quote: If the app normally confirms a successful booking through an existing message or channel, a member booked through the waitlist receives that same type of confirmation.
verdicts.missing: What the promotion notice says, and what happens when sending it fails.

verdicts.quote: allocating a place through the waitlist never causes the confirmed count to exceed 1, even when requests overlap.
An ordinary booking request overlaps the release of 1 place while an eligible entry is active. The place goes through the waitlist.
verdicts.missing: What happens when the waiting member themselves books directly while being promoted, e.g. avoiding a duplicate booking for that member.

verdicts.quote: If the existing flow requires payment authorization, approval, or another prerequisite ... a member has a confirmed booking through the waitlist only after meeting that prerequisite.
verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking, and what happens to the place and the entry when payment fails.

verdicts.quote: The waitlist has no separate per-session enrollment limit ... An otherwise eligible member can join a full bookable session regardless of the number of existing waiting entries.
If 1 place opens at or after the point the ordinary booking flow closes, 0 new bookings are confirmed through the waitlist.
the scheduler increases a full session from capacity 1 to capacity 2 during booking. The new place can be allocated through the waitlist.
After bookings close, including through session cancellation, a previously waiting member can tell that their entry is no longer active.
Allocation selects eligible entries in the order those entries became active
verdicts.missing: The entry's record fields and states, and whether queue position is stored or derived from join time.

verdicts.quote: Closing a session to further bookings ends its active waitlist for that booking period
verdicts.missing: How long ended entries are kept after the class has run, and whether they are deleted or archived.

verdicts.quote: A caller who lacks access to another member's booking status cannot retrieve that member's waitlist status.
verdicts.missing: Whether a member can see their own position in the queue, and whether the identities of others waiting are hidden from members.

verdicts.quote: An existing full session can accept waitlist joins without new operator configuration
verdicts.missing: Whether the feature can be turned off globally, or enabled or disabled per class or class type.

verdicts.quote: Ordinary booking remains available when a session has an available place with nobody waiting
The operator starts the updated app with the existing class and booking settings. An otherwise eligible member can join the waitlist of a session that was already full.
